messages:
incidents-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for /v2/streaming (p99=4.12s > SLO 3.0s). Elevated tail stalls + increased cache miss rate on prefix namespace 'model_v2/pfx'. Auto-escalation -> paging Alice Chen. Incident created INC-20260315-321. Please ack and triage.

Alice Chen: acked. I'm oncall. Pulling up per-route dashboards and traces now. tagging @Raj and @Maria for runtime/cache context.

Raj Patel: on it. early look at cache metrics shows prefix_hit_rate dropping from 92% -> 55% in last 12m for the affected shard group. evictions and namespace rotation spiked at 12:01Z.

Maria Gomez: thanks. any recent changes to prefix hashing or rollout? I know we pushed the v3 prefix-hash rollout to canary yesterday evening.

Raj Patel: yes v3 was pushed to 20% canary at ~2026-03-15T11:45Z. Canary traffic shows much higher key cardinality and lower locality -> caching ineffective.

Alice Chen: OK mitigation options: 1) pause/rollback prefix-hash v3 canary (fast) 2) enable cache bypass + short-circuit to smaller model variant for streaming flows (safer) 3) temporary global cache warmup (hard). What do we want?

Kevin Liu: from CS: Customer AcmeFinance is on the hosted Dedicated tier and reported elevated tail latency in logs ~12:05Z. They are starting to escalate to their SRE.

Maria Gomez: Recommend immediate rollback of prefix-hash canary to v2 on canary hosts and enable fallback routing for streaming to model_v1-small. Rolling back should bring hit-rate back in minutes.

Raj Patel: I can flip rollback now. Command: ```
# rollback prefix-hash canary
redwoodctl rollout prefix-hash set --name=prefix-hash-v2 --target=canary --percent=100
# verify
redwoodctl metrics query "prefix_hit_rate{namespace='model_v2/pfx'}" --rate=1m
``` 
I'll run and post results.

Alice Chen: do it. Also add a temporary rule in routing to prefer cached path for streaming with ttl=60s and disable aggressive eviction if possible.

Raj Patel: executing rollback... now.

incidents-bot: Action logged: rollback command issued by Raj Patel at 2026-03-15T12:09:10Z. Run ID rnd-9a7c.

Raj Patel: rollback completed on canary group at 12:10:02Z. Initial metrics: prefix_hit_rate climbing -> 78% after 2m. p95 dropped from 1.2s -> 0.8s, p99 trending down.

Maria Gomez: pushing fallback rule for streaming: ```
# prefer model_v1-small for streaming when latency>SLO
redwoodctl route update /v2/streaming --fallback-model=model_v1-small --enabled=true
``` 
Applied. Observability note: keep an eye on quality signals.

Alice Chen: good. I'm going to open a brief customer-facing note and loop Kevin for comms. Kevin, please pre-draft a status update: what customers to notify and suggested wording.

Kevin Liu: drafting. Suggested blurb: "We're investigating an internal cache hashing rollout that caused elevated tail latency. We've rolled back the canary and performance is improving. If you see any continued degradation, reply and we'll prioritize your traffic." Will send to AcmeFinance in 5m.

incidents-bot: Metric alert cleared for p95 on /v2/streaming at 12:14:40Z. p99 still above threshold but trending down. Keep monitoring.

Raj Patel: p99 now 2.9s at 12:15:30Z (breach borderline). Cache_miss_rate for model_v2/pfx  fell from 45% -> 14% since rollback.

Maria Gomez: I'll coordinate a slow rollforward plan for prefix-hash v3 with more conservative salting and namespace bucketing. Also add a canary traffic generator to mimic heavy cardinality keys before broader rollout.

Alice Chen: action items: Raj - run extended validation on canary rollback and verify no residual evictions; Maria - design safer v3 rollout and test harness; Kevin - customer comms sent; Tom - prepare night handoff notes. If p99 holds under SLO for 30m we will close incident.

Tom O'Neill: noted. I'll take handoff at 12:40Z if still open. Preparing runbook excerpt and timeline for night oncall.

Alice Chen: thanks team. current status: mitigation applied (rollback + fallback), customer notified, metrics improving. Keeping incident open for 30m of stable SLOs. I'll update INC-20260315-321 with timeline and root-cause hypothesis (prefix-hash v3 increased key entropy -> poor cache locality -> eviction storm -> tail stalls).

incidents-bot: Reminder: add post-incident summary and set RCA owner. Suggested labels: prefix-hash, cache-regression, streaming, p99, rollback.

Alice Chen: setting RCA owner to Maria Gomez and will schedule RCA meeting tomorrow. Closing slack thread for live mitigation updates; continue updates in INC ticket. :thumbsup:
